title: erodium cicutarium subsp. dissectum
intro: Erodium cicutarium subsp. dissectum, commonly known as Red-stemmed Stork's-bill or Red-stemmed Geranium, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and provide relief from respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Erodium cicutarium subsp. dissectum are responsible for its therapeutic actions, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential as a medicinal herb.
